name: Cheesy "Pizza" Lasagna with Ricotta, Pepperoni, Mushrooms & Olives (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Preheat oven to 350°F. Use your fingers to coat a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with oil.
Place cheese, ricotta, sliced mushrooms, drained olives, and pepperoni each in their own small bowl. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups shredded cheese, Italian blend
1 (425 g) pkg ricotta cheese
1 (227 g) pkg sliced white mushrooms
1 (184 g) can sliced black olives
1 (170 g) pkg pepperoni

instructions.primary_message: Add marinara sauce to the baking dish, spreading it out in an even layer, then arrange lasagna noodles on top (break noodles to fit as necessary).
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup marinara sauce
4 no-boil lasagna noodles

instructions.primary_message: Using one-third of each ingredient at a time, spread more marinara sauce over the noodles. Sprinkle cheese over the sauce, then drop dollops of ricotta on top. Top with mushrooms, olives, and pepperoni, then cover with more noodles. Repeat with remaining ingredients, creating 3 layers with the "pizza" toppings on top. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil.

Place lasagna in the oven and bake until noodles are cooked through and cheese is bubbly, about 45 minutes. Remove the foil and continue to bake until the lasagna is lightly golden brown, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand, 10 minutes.
Cut lasagna into 8 portions, share, and enjoy!
